name: strategy
description: Vintage, roll-rate, profitability, governed univariate candidate refinement and Strategy Pool assembly, strategy construction, deterministic application, backtesting, and tradeoff analysis tools.

tools.name: vintage_curve
tools.summary: Compute a strategy-facing vintage curve from the shared deterministic vintage core.

tools.name: roll_rate_matrix
tools.summary: Compute a roll-rate transition matrix from customer status sequences.

tools.name: profit_calc
tools.summary: Calculate deterministic segment profitability from EAD, PD, and cost parameters.

tools.name: analyze_univariate_candidates
tools.summary: Deterministically analyze bounded numeric and categorical fields, preserve canonical bin conditions, and emit development-only candidate evidence with JSON/XLSX reports.

tools.name: refine_univariate_candidate
tools.summary: Replay task-owned univariate evidence, apply explicit bin merges and deterministic selection, and emit an immutable development-only candidate asset.

tools.name: add_candidate_to_pool
tools.summary: Add one immutable task-owned Candidate Asset to a draft Strategy Pool revision after strict parent-evidence, dataset, and optimistic-lock validation.

tools.name: remove_pool_entry
tools.summary: Remove one Strategy Pool membership by stable rule_id and persist a new draft revision; no strategy is adopted or deployed.

tools.name: set_pool_entry_action
tools.summary: Replace the Pool-owned typed action for one stable rule_id and persist a new draft revision.

tools.name: reorder_strategy_pool
tools.summary: Persist one complete, duplicate-free stable rule_id ordering as a new draft Strategy Pool revision.

tools.name: compile_strategy_pool
tools.summary: Compile an exact current Strategy Pool revision to canonical StrategySpec and SelectedStrategyDesign hashes without dataset execution, persistence, adoption, or deployment.

tools.name: design_strategy_candidate
tools.summary: Deterministically design a limit, pricing, or segmentation candidate from a task-owned dataset and bounded user search inputs.

tools.name: build_strategy
tools.summary: Validate and persist a deterministic strategy rule set.

tools.name: apply_strategy
tools.summary: Apply a persisted canonical strategy to a task-owned dataset and atomically register deterministic per-row actions as a derived dataset.

tools.name: backtest_strategy
tools.summary: Backtest a persisted strategy on a dataset and persist aggregate results.

tools.name: tradeoff_view
tools.summary: Scan score cutoffs and recommend an operating point under risk constraints.

tools.name: design_cutoff_bands
tools.summary: Split scores into deterministic bands and recommend a monotone approve/decline cut under risk constraints.

tools.name: compare_strategies
tools.summary: Compare a candidate strategy against a baseline on a dataset with a 2x2 agreement matrix and deltas.

tools.name: adopt_strategy
tools.summary: Adopt a task-bound approval, reject, limit, pricing, or segmentation strategy behind a mandatory confirmation gate; emit aggregate audit evidence, a decision table, and a type-specific monitoring plan.

band_stats.description: Deprecated stored-plan compatibility input. Adoption ignores these unbound caller statistics and derives deliverables only from persisted strategy/backtest evidence.

lifecycle_notice.const: 本地已采纳，不代表生产上线。

tools.name: render_strategy_doc
tools.summary: Render a Chinese-language strategy markdown document from persisted strategy, backtests, and artifacts.

tools.name: mine_rules
tools.summary: Mine deterministic candidate reject rules from a labeled sample via decision-tree paths and univariate cutpoints.

tools.name: evaluate_rule_set
tools.summary: Evaluate an ordered rule subset with a first-match-wins waterfall, overlap matrix, and residual/combined stats.

tools.name: select_rule_set
tools.summary: Assemble the user-selected ordered subset of mined candidate rules into a gate payload.

tools.name: run_strategy_monitoring
tools.summary: Run one evidence-bound monitoring pass for a locally adopted strategy asset: model PSI/CSI when model-backed plus type-specific strategy and economics checks, persisted to the immutable monitoring plan/run ledger; local adoption does not imply production deployment.

tools.name: apply_monitoring_disposition
tools.summary: Apply a human-confirmed response to the latest evidence-bound monitoring run: acknowledge a non-red run, record observe for red, atomically rerun a validated threshold revision, or create a real draft strategy task/version from red evidence.

tools.name: render_monitoring_report
tools.summary: Render an immutable content-addressed Markdown report from a verified monitoring-run ledger entry and its hash-bound executed disposition receipt; caller-supplied verdicts, checks and handoff claims are not accepted.

tools.name: limit_pricing_matrix
tools.summary: Deterministic band x limit x rate expected-profit grid with EL simulation; exports task-owned CSV and Markdown only after the matrix confirmation gate.

tools.name: render_challenger_report
tools.summary: Assemble a challenger-vs-champion Markdown report from task-owned persisted strategies and a challenger backtest receipt; recomputes report evidence and canonical local-adoption status. No-op when no champion is supplied.
